verdict.rationale: Typesense is open-source (GPL-3.0) and the docs explicitly state Cloud is just the hosted SaaS version of the same open-source product, with self-host options spanning Docker, Docker Compose, Kubernetes, Homebrew, binaries, DEB/RPM packages, and Terraform modules. A runtime probe confirms a real local install (`typesense-server --version`) with no account required, successfully performing a full typo-tolerant index+search roundtrip identical to what the hosted product offers. Missing for 10: independent large-scale production benchmarks proving full feature parity (e.g., cloud-only extras like Search Delivery Network/HA are infra conveniences, not engine features, but this distinction isn't explicitly documented).
